trigger: A recovery code was used to sign in (twofactor.js)
subject: A recovery code was used
footer_note: You're getting this because you have a VF Tech account. Account emails like this one can't be turned off.
body: Someone signed in to your VFTech account with a recovery code. {{left}} unused {{codes_word}} left. If you've lost your phone, turn two-factor off and on again from your account page to move it to a new one.
If this wasn't you, reply to this email or use the Can't sign in? page straight away.
